focus.zh: 台灣與東南亞半導體設備、雷射封裝、晶圓測試、伺服器電源與工廠工程
focus.en: Taiwan and Southeast Asian semiconductor tools, laser packaging, wafer test, server power and industrial engineering

throughline.zh: 業成公布跨台灣與越南的雷射封裝規劃，台達電與光寶科揭露電源業務月報，漢測及崇越則提供晶圓測試和記憶體廠環保工程的營收資訊。
throughline.en: GIS-KY detailed Taiwan/Vietnam laser packaging plans, Delta and Lite-On disclosed power-related sales, and Hermes Testing and Topco reported wafer-test and memory-fab environmental engineering activity.

text.zh: 業成規劃高功率雷射封裝產線年底小量生產，2027 年中放量，資本支出約 40 至 50 億元。
text.en: GIS-KY targets year-end laser packaging pilot output and a mid-2027 ramp, with NT$4B–5B allocated.

text.zh: 台達電 10 月營收 746.66 億元，電源與零組件事業占 51%。
text.en: Delta's October revenue reached NT$74.666B; power and components contributed 51%.

text.zh: 漢測 10 月營收 5.06 億元、年增 61.88%，公司提及晶圓測試熱管理與清潔材料需求。
text.en: Hermes Testing reported NT$506M October sales, up 61.88% YoY, citing test thermal management.

text.zh: 光寶科 10 月營收 200.71 億元，雲端及物聯網事業占 66%，包含伺服器電源與 BBU。
text.en: Lite-On reported NT$20.071B October sales; cloud and IoT comprised 66%, including server PSUs and BBUs.

text.zh: 廣達 10 月營收約 3,532.5 億元、年增約 104%，公司表示主要由 AI 伺服器推動。
text.en: Quanta reported NT$353.25B October sales, up about 104% YoY, citing AI servers.

title.zh: 業成公布高功率雷射封裝新時程，年底小量生產、2027 年中擬放量
title.en: GIS-KY targets small-batch high-power laser packaging by year-end, with a mid-2027 ramp

summary.zh: 業成 GIS-KY 11 月 9 日法說會表示，高功率雷射封裝產線預計 2026 年 11 至 12 月小量生產，2027 年第二季底至第三季放量，初期預計為 1 至 2 家客戶代工。公司表示今年董事會已核准資本支出約 80 億元，約 40 至 50 億元配置雷射封裝，其中台灣與越南兩地產線均有規劃；尚未公布實際量產驗收。
summary.en: At its November 9 investor briefing, GIS-KY said high-power laser packaging could begin small-batch output in November or December 2026 and ramp from late Q2 to Q3 2027 for one or two initial customers. Of roughly NT$8 billion in previously approved 2026 capital spending, NT$4 billion to NT$5 billion is allocated to laser packaging in Taiwan and Vietnam; completed customer acceptance has not been announced.

text.zh: 業成原以觸控顯示模組為主要業務，目前開發光通訊雷射委外封裝、300 至 400mW 高功率連續波雷射產品、VCSEL 及光纖陣列元件。不同技術的工程驗證與量產時間需個別核對。
text.en: GIS-KY's original business centers on touch-display modules; it is developing laser outsourced assembly, 300–400mW continuous-wave devices, VCSEL-related products and fiber-array components. Their qualification and mass-production stages differ.

text.zh: 中央社引述公司管理階層表示，約 40 至 50 億元雷射封裝資本支出中約三分之一投向台灣，其餘供應越南新廠。公司第三季合併營收為 144.56 億元、季增 37.6%、年減 10.5%，稅後淨損 7.25 億元；財報涵蓋既有業務，未拆出雷射封裝獲利。
text.en: Management told CNA that roughly one-third of the NT$4–5 billion laser allocation goes to Taiwan and the remainder to Vietnam. Q3 consolidated revenue was NT$14.456 billion, up 37.6% QoQ but down 10.5% YoY, with an after-tax loss of NT$725 million. These group results do not isolate laser packaging.

text.zh: 雷射封裝設備規格、量產良率、個別客戶合約、越南廠城市及驗收時間尚未公布。
text.en: Laser packaging tool specifications, yields, individual customer contracts, the Vietnam facility's city and acceptance dates remain undisclosed.

title.zh: 台達電 10 月營收 746.66 億元，電源及零組件事業占 51%
title.en: Delta October revenue reaches NT$74.666B; power and components account for 51%

summary.zh: 台達電 11 月 9 日公布 10 月合併營收 746.66 億元，年增約 30%、月增 14.2%，為單月新高；前十月累計 6,143.34 億元，年增 36.3%。公司說明當月電源及零組件占營收 51%，基礎設施占 36%，但未提供資料中心電源獨立出貨量。
summary.en: Delta reported October consolidated sales of NT$74.666 billion on November 9, about 30% higher YoY and up 14.2% MoM, setting a monthly record; Jan–Oct sales reached NT$614.334 billion, up 36.3%. The company reported 51% of sales from power and components and 36% from infrastructure without individual data-center PSU units.

text.zh: 台達電的產品涉及資料中心供電、電源轉換、配電、工業自動化與散熱。公司事業群占比包含多個產品與終端，不能將電源及零組件的 51% 直接視為機櫃電源營收。
text.en: Delta serves data-center power conversion, distribution, industrial automation and cooling. Business-group percentages span multiple products and markets; the 51% figure is not a distinct rack-PSU revenue total.

text.zh: 台達電官方英文公告確認 10 月營收 74,666 百萬元。中央社轉述電源及零組件、基礎設施、自動化及交通事業群占比分別為 51%、36%、8%、5%；四類合計 100%。
text.en: Delta's original November 9 press release confirms October sales of NT$74,666 million. CNA reports group shares of 51% power and components, 36% infrastructure, 8% automation and 5% mobility, together totaling 100%.

text.zh: 800V DC 供電系統出貨、伺服器機櫃電源量及各產品營收未公開。
text.en: 800V DC system shipments, server rack PSU volumes and product-level revenue were not disclosed.

title.zh: 漢測 10 月營收 5.06 億元、年增 61.88%，測試機熱管理與清潔材料列為成長來源
title.en: Hermes Testing October sales rise 61.88% YoY to NT$506M, citing tester thermal management

summary.zh: 漢測 11 月 9 日公布 10 月營收約 5.06 億元，年增 61.88%、月減 1.67%，前十月累計約 41.91 億元、年增 118.13%。公司指出熱管理模組、晶圓測試探針清潔材料及工程服務帶動業務，但未分別公布產品出貨件數。
summary.en: Hermes Testing reported approximately NT$506 million in October sales on November 9, up 61.88% YoY and down 1.67% MoM; January–October sales reached about NT$4.191 billion, up 118.13%. The company cited thermal modules, probe-cleaning materials and engineering services but did not break out units.

text.zh: 漢測針對高功耗晶片測試提供整合在測試機與晶圓針測機之間的熱管理模組，另提供清潔材料、針測機維護及薄膜探針卡等業務。已有薄膜探針卡小量交貨，但 CPO 測試仍屬布局項目。
text.en: Hermes provides thermal-management modules installed between wafer probers and test systems, as well as cleaning materials, prober maintenance and film probe cards. Some thin-film probe-card deliveries have started, while CPO test remains a development area.

text.zh: 公司對媒體指出 10 月約 5.06 億元、9 月約 5.14 億元、去年 10 月約 3.12 億元，前十月約 41.91 億元。數字是四捨五入值，年增率使用公布的 61.88% 與 118.13%，未反推精確比較基期。
text.en: Reports cite rounded October, September and year-earlier sales of NT$506 million, NT$514 million and NT$312 million, respectively. The company published YoY growth of 61.88% and ten-month growth of 118.13%; precise comparison bases are not calculated from rounded values.

text.zh: 熱管理模組的套數、散熱規格、單價、薄膜探針卡收入與客戶驗收未量化。
text.en: Thermal module units, cooling specifications, prices, film probe-card revenue and customer acceptance volumes were not quantified.

title.zh: 光寶科 10 月營收 200.71 億元，雲端及物聯網業務占 66%
title.en: Lite-On October sales reach NT$20.071B; cloud and IoT account for 66%

summary.zh: 光寶科 11 月 9 日公布 10 月營收 200.71 億元，年增 32.01%、月增約 6.5%，前十月累計營收約 1,736.29 億元。公司指出高階伺服器電源、電池備援系統 BBU 和光電半導體需求，雲端及物聯網事業占當月營收 66%，未提供 BBU 的單獨出貨數。
summary.en: Lite-On reported October revenue of NT$20.071 billion on November 9, up 32.01% YoY and approximately 6.5% MoM, with ten-month sales about NT$173.629 billion. It cited high-end server power supplies, battery backup units and optoelectronic demand; cloud and IoT contributed 66% of sales, with no BBU unit count.

text.zh: 光寶科電能管理產品包括 AI 伺服器供電與機櫃電池備援，與資料中心持續供電及電力轉換相關。公司先前提出 800V DC Power Rack 樣機及其他高功率電源產品的開發時程，尚未以本月數字拆出出貨量。
text.en: Lite-On supplies server PSUs and rack battery backup within data-center power infrastructure. Earlier 800V DC Power Rack prototypes and power-shelf roadmaps were not separately quantified in October results.

text.zh: 公司公布雲端及物聯網部門占 66%、光電 13%、資訊及消費性電子 21%。中央社報導前十月累計營收年增約 26.8%，高於 2025 全年營收 1,660.84 億元，兩者分別為十個月與十二個月。
text.en: The business-unit mix is cloud and IoT 66%, optoelectronics 13%, and information and consumer electronics 21%. Ten-month revenue rose around 26.8% and exceeded the NT$166.084 billion recorded for all of 2025, a comparison between differently sized periods.

text.zh: 伺服器電源、BBU 與 800V DC 機櫃分產品營收、交貨與驗收件數未公布。
text.en: Product-level server PSU, BBU and 800V DC rack revenue, deliveries and acceptances were not disclosed.

title.zh: 廣達 10 月營收約 3,532.5 億元，年增 104%，公司稱主要由 AI 伺服器推動
title.en: Quanta October revenue reaches NT$353.25B, up about 104% YoY; company cites AI servers

summary.zh: 廣達 11 月 9 日公布 10 月營收約 3,532.5 億元，月增 8.6%、年增約 104%，前十月累計約 3.31 兆元，年增 99.9%。公司表示成長主要來自 AI 伺服器，同期筆電出貨為 270 萬台，但未提供 GPU 機櫃或伺服器各產品實際出貨量。
summary.en: Quanta reported October consolidated sales of about NT$353.25 billion on November 9, up 8.6% MoM and roughly 104% YoY; ten-month sales reached approximately NT$3.31 trillion, up 99.9%. The company attributed growth mainly to AI servers and reported 2.7 million notebook shipments, without GPU rack or server-model unit counts.

text.zh: 廣達生產伺服器 ODM、機櫃系統與筆電整機，合併營收涵蓋不同產品及交易方式。整體營收年增率無法直接套用於 GPU 機櫃出貨量。
text.en: Quanta provides server ODM, rack systems and PCs; revenue spans different product lines and commercial terms. Group revenue growth is not a GPU-rack unit growth rate.

text.zh: 廣達 10 月筆電出貨 270 萬台，比 9 月減少 150 萬台。公司表示預定 11 月 11 日在法人說明會更新第四季展望，該資訊截至 11 月 9 日尚未公布。
text.en: Notebook shipments were 2.7 million units, down 1.5 million from September. The company said Q4 guidance would be updated at a November 11 investor briefing, which had not yet taken place by the cutoff.

text.zh: AI 伺服器營收占比、機櫃出貨、客戶驗收及電力散熱機櫃配置未公布。
text.en: AI-server revenue share, rack shipments, customer acceptance and power/cooling configurations were not disclosed.

title.zh: 崇越 10 月營收 81.86 億元，指出先進製程材料與記憶體廠廢水工程挹注
title.en: Topco October revenue reaches NT$8.186B, citing process materials and memory-fab wastewater work

summary.zh: 崇越 11 月 9 日公布 10 月營收 81.86 億元，月增 6.3%、年增 61.2%，前十月累計 712.15 億元、年增 28.6%。公司表示先進半導體材料出貨及國際記憶體客戶的廢水處理工程按完工比例認列營收，未披露工程合約總額。
summary.en: Topco reported October revenue of NT$8.186 billion on November 9, up 6.3% MoM and 61.2% YoY, with ten-month revenue of NT$71.215 billion, up 28.6%. It cited advanced semiconductor materials and progress-based revenue recognition for a memory-fab wastewater project, without the contract value.

text.zh: 崇越經營晶圓製程材料與晶圓廠環境工程。建越科技的記憶體廠專案涉及氨氮與異丙醇廢水及相關處理工法，與材料銷售分屬不同業務。
text.en: Topco supplies wafer process materials and fab environmental systems. Its subsidiary's memory-fab project covers ammonia-nitrogen and isopropyl alcohol wastewater treatment, a distinct business from materials distribution.

text.zh: 崇越表示記憶體廠工程按完工比例法認列營收，並涉及觸媒、高級氧化及生物處理技術。10 月收入超過今年 7 月 81.74 億元單月紀錄，前十月收入已超過 2025 全年 675.84 億元；比較期間不同。
text.en: The company uses percentage-of-completion accounting for the wastewater project, involving catalytic, advanced oxidation and biological treatment. October exceeded July's NT$8.174 billion record and ten-month sales surpassed full-year 2025 revenue of NT$67.584 billion; these are different reporting windows.

text.zh: 工程客戶名稱、廢水處理設備規格、進度百分比與驗收條件未公布。
text.en: The project customer, wastewater tool specifications, percentage completion and acceptance terms were not disclosed.

title.zh: 來頡稱成熟製程與封測供應吃緊，第三季毛利率降至 44%
title.en: M3 Technology cites mature-node and back-end constraints; Q3 gross margin falls to 44%

summary.zh: 電源管理 IC 設計商來頡 11 月 9 日法說會表示，成熟製程晶圓代工與後段封測產能供應趨緊，預期 2027 年成本上升。公司第三季毛利率為 44%，較第二季下降 2 個百分點，稅後淨利 4,742 萬元、季減 14%；未提供已生效的晶圓代工漲價幅度。
summary.en: Power-management IC designer M3 Technology said on November 9 that mature-node wafer and back-end test capacity is tightening and expects cost increases in 2027. Its Q3 gross margin was 44%, down two percentage points QoQ, and net profit was NT$47.42 million, down 14% QoQ; no implemented foundry price increase was disclosed.

text.zh: 來頡的電源管理 IC 涉及成熟製程晶圓代工、封測及 WiFi 路由器等客戶應用。公司表示 WiFi 7 部分平台導入較預期保守，將記憶體材料成本列為考量之一，仍屬公司市場觀察。
text.en: M3 Technology designs power-management ICs using outsourced mature-node fabrication and packaging/test for networking markets. It said WiFi 7 platform adoption is more conservative, partly citing memory costs; this remains its market assessment.

text.zh: 公司法說指出毛利率由第二季 46% 降至第三季 44%，降幅為 2 個百分點。管理層表示將增加合格供應商及與客戶協商價格，但尚未確認實際調價或新增產能。
text.en: Q3 gross margin fell from 46% in Q2 to 44%, a two-percentage-point move. Management described supply diversification and price discussions but did not announce finalized increases or added capacity.

text.zh: 晶圓及封測個別成本漲幅、客戶調價、供應商稼動率及新產能均未公布。
text.en: Foundry and OSAT cost increases, customer price changes, supplier utilization and new capacity remain unknown.

title.en: Yageo October revenue reaches NT$17.597B, up 55% YoY, across specialty and standard components

summary.zh: 國巨 11 月 9 日公布 10 月自結合併營收 175.97 億元，月增 3.1%、年增 55%，前十月累計 1,497.51 億元、年增 38.3%。公司稱特殊品與標準品需求皆增加，先前預期第四季產能利用率高於 95% 屬前瞻估計，尚無本月實測數字。
summary.en: Yageo reported unaudited October consolidated revenue of NT$17.597 billion on November 9, up 3.1% MoM and 55% YoY, with ten-month sales of NT$149.751 billion, up 38.3%. The company cited growth in both specialty and standard components; earlier guidance for utilization above 95% in Q4 is a forecast, not a measured October figure.

text.zh: 國巨被動元件廣泛用於伺服器電源、工控、網通及其他終端。個別品類的需求、庫存與價格不一定隨集團營收同比變化。
text.en: Yageo's passive components serve server power, industrial controls, networking and other electronics, with different product-level orders and inventory conditions.

text.zh: 公司表示 10 月亞洲假期減少工作天數，但收入仍較 9 月增加。先前公布的產能擴增 10% 至 15% 及 2027 年分階段到位規劃仍屬公司目標。
text.en: Management said fewer Asian workdays did not prevent October sequential growth. Earlier guidance for 10%–15% extra capacity phased through 2027 remains a plan.

text.zh: 各元件類別的實際出貨量、價格與第四季實際產能利用率未公布。
text.en: Part-level shipments, prices and realized Q4 utilization were not disclosed.

title.en: ASUS October revenue reaches NT$107.62B, up 62.3% YoY, citing deferred server deliveries

summary.zh: 華碩 11 月 9 日公布 10 月集團合併營收 1,076.2 億元，月增 10.7%、年增 62.3%，前十月累計 8,500.56 億元，年增 41.1%。公司指出伺服器出貨及先前遞延訂單完成交貨認列貢獻營收，但未公布 GPU 機櫃或伺服器獨立出貨數量。
summary.en: ASUS reported October group consolidated sales of NT$107.62 billion on November 9, up 10.7% MoM and 62.3% YoY, with ten-month sales of NT$850.056 billion, up 41.1%. The company cited server deliveries and recognition of previously deferred orders without disclosing GPU rack or separate server units.

text.zh: 華碩集團收入包括 PC、伺服器與多種電子終端。伺服器遞延訂單交付代表既有訂單在本期認列，不能視為當期新增簽約金額。
text.en: ASUS group revenue includes PCs, servers and other systems. Delivering previously delayed server orders relates to revenue-recognition timing, not newly booked order values.

text.zh: 公司表示集團及品牌營收均突破 1,000 億元；10 月成長來自伺服器交貨動能與先前延後認列的訂單。前十月合併收入年增約 41.1%。
text.en: The company said group and brand monthly sales both passed NT$100 billion, supported by server shipments and earlier deferred deliveries. Jan–Oct revenue increased about 41.1% YoY.

text.zh: 伺服器與 PC 分項營收、機櫃電力規格、機種出貨和期末遞延訂單餘額未公布。
text.en: Server versus PC revenue, rack power ratings, model shipments and remaining deferred backlog are not available.

verificationNote.zh: 台達電合併營收有公司原始公告，其事業群比重由中央社轉述；其他部分數據由可信媒體引述公司資料，未逐一直接取得交易所原始申報。業成與越南雷射封裝產線時程屬規劃，漢測與光寶科未公布各產品獨立出貨。來頡預期 2027 年成本上升、國巨產能利用率與擴產時程均為公司前瞻說法。
verificationNote.en: Delta's headline sales are backed by its original release, while group composition is reported by CNA. Some other company figures were reported by established news outlets without independently obtained original exchange filings. GIS-KY's laser ramp remains prospective, and Hermes and Lite-On do not disclose individual product shipments. M3's future costs and Yageo's capacity expectations are management outlooks.
